name: Foreign Exchange Trade Withdrawal Notification V 03
definition: Scope|The ForeignExchangeTradeWithdrawalNotification message is sent by a central system to notify the withdrawal of a foreign exchange trade which was previously notified to the receiver as an alleged trade.|Usage|The ForeignExchangeTradeWithdrawalNotification message is used to confirm the cancellation of a previously notified trade.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Identification of the present message assigned by the party issuing the message. This identification must be unique amongst all messages of same type sent by the same party.

MatchingSystemUniqueReference.name: Matching System Unique Reference
MatchingSystemUniqueReference.definition: Reference to the unique system identification assigned to the trade by the central matching system.

SettlementSessionIdentifier.name: Settlement Session Identifier
SettlementSessionIdentifier.definition: To indicate the requested CLS Settlement Session that the related trade is part of.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
